claim: With this change, CloudFront customers never incur CloudFront request fees or data transfer charges for requests blocked by AWS WAF. The fact covers CloudFront charges only, not AWS WAF's own charges.

qualifiers.scope: CloudFront request fees and data transfer charges for requests blocked by AWS WAF; AWS WAF charges are out of scope

note: d133; register-15: the change date is the 'Effective October 25, 2024' of the post (posted 2024-11-06); older questions may assume blocked requests still cost request fees. adjudicate-15: the effective date stands only in changed.date (checked by the currency lens against the change item); no saved page holds it as a quotable sentence, so the claim no longer states it. spot-15: the same post says 'AWS WAF will continue billing for evaluating and blocking these requests.' That sentence cannot be quoted (in the saved JSON snapshot it is not on a sentence boundary, and robots.txt disallows the post page), so the claim is narrowed to CloudFront charges; writers must not say blocked requests cost nothing at all.
